title: Not Worth the Price
text: Not Worth the Price. This travel mug is relatively stylish and it works well. However, it is overpriced, difficult to clean, and the ceramic top is not a good design choice as it can and will break easily.

product_metadata.title: Elemental Artisan Insulated Tumbler, Triple Wall Coffee Travel Mug, Reusable Stainless Steel Coffee Tumbler with Ceramic Lid, Thermal Coffee Cups for Hot (6 Hrs) & Cold (18 Hrs), 16oz - Robin's Egg
features: Keeps Beverages Hot or Cold for Hours - Our vacuum insulated tumbler for coffee and tea boasts of triple wall vacuum copper insulation, an upgrade from double wall tumbler. A coffee mug that keeps drinks hot for 6 hours or cold for 18 hours.

Convenient Spill Resistant Thermal Cup - Our metal insulated cup with copper lining has a ceramic lid that provides a great mouthfeel, with a silicone plug that fits snugly into the opening for spill-resistance. Note that the lid isn't leak proof.

Provides Stable and Comfortable Grip - Our travel tumblers have a 3in diameter, textured band, and non-slip silicone bottom for easy grip. The No Sweat Design prevents condensation, keeping your hands dry when holding an ice-cold drink on a hot day.
Better for You and The Planet - Ditch single-use water cups and switch to our reusable coffee travel mug. It's durable, BPA free, and doesn't transfer flavor.

Choose from our Sleek and Stylish Designs - We combine style and function in our insulated coffee tumbler. Select one from our simple yet stylish colors or collect them all! Choose from our insulated coffee cups with lids 12 oz and 16 oz.
